explication: Marigold adapts pretrained diffusion models for three dense-image tasks: depth, surface normals, and intrinsic image decomposition (IID). The user-facing workflow is image input → task-specific prediction pipeline → task output; pipelines also support ensembling and uncertainty. Separate training, dataset, evaluation, and preprocessing code supports model development and assessment. The README documents the capabilities, while sampled pipeline and trainer excerpts show some implementation details; several script and dataset relationships are therefore left unconnected where source evidence is unavailable.
